flipRule: stable may become true only through an owner edit that populates every ownerManual pre-publication field with owner-written evidence, together with the matching edit to test/tools/release-state.test.cjs. The six pre-publication gates are pilotInstallBySecondPerson, evidenceRecord, branchProtection, devArchival, releaseEnvironment, and immutableReleases; none of them requires a tag or Release that cannot exist before tagging. publication.tagAndRelease is separate post-publication evidence and is required only for PUBLISHED_VERIFIED, never for stable:true. No npm script, test, build step, or CI job may set stable:true or publication.tagAndRelease.
